python3 -u - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib, resource, signal, sys, time
from hashlib import sha256
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU, (170,175))
signal.alarm(180)
sys.path[:0] = ['peano-lab/py','scripts']
import pytest
paths = [pathlib.Path('research/arithmetic-library/working/prime-field-gcd-existence-v1') / n for n in ('prime_field_polynomial_gcd_existence_candidate.py','test_prime_field_polynomial_gcd_existence_candidate.py')]
pins = {str(p): [p.stat().st_size,sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()] for p in paths}
class Log:
    def __init__(self): self.phases=[]; self.collected=[]
    def pytest_collection_finish(self, session): self.collected=[x.nodeid for x in session.items]
    def pytest_runtest_logreport(self, report): self.phases.append(dict(nodeid=report.nodeid,when=report.when,outcome=report.outcome,duration=report.duration))
log=Log(); start=time.monotonic()
print(json.dumps(dict(kind='native-body-inputs',pins=pins)),flush=True)
status=pytest.main(["research/arithmetic-library/working/prime-field-gcd-existence-v1/test_prime_field_polynomial_gcd_existence_candidate.py::test_native_body[row00]",'-q','-s','-x','-p','no:cacheprovider'],plugins=[log])
after={str(p):[p.stat().st_size,sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()] for p in paths}
assert after==pins
peak=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss
assert peak <= 1610612736
assert resource.getrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU)==(170,175)
print(json.dumps(dict(kind='native-body-result',status=int(status),elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-start,peak_rss_bytes=peak,pins=pins,unchanged=True,collected=log.collected,phases=log.phases,conditional_only=True,admission_performed=False)),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(status)
PY
